descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# **Pro Basketball Nations**

Experience the excitement of international basketball in VR! Take control of your players and compete for glory in immersive full-length matches against intelligent AI opponents—all **offline**, no internet required.

Choose from **200+ national teams** and compete in world and continental tournaments, or create your own custom competitions with your favorite nations and rules.

Built specifically for virtual reality, Pro Basketball Nations features comfortable movement designed to minimize VR discomfort while keeping you fully immersed in the action.

**Features**

* 200+ national teams
* World & continental tournaments
* Create custom tournaments
* Control all players
* Intelligent AI opponents
* Multiple difficulty levels
* Comfortable VR gameplay
* Fully offline—no internet required

# **Lead Your Nation to Glory**

Every pass matters.

Every tackle counts.

Every goal brings you one step closer to becoming world champion.

Put on your headset, step onto the pitch, and experience the passion, excitement, and drama of international basketball in Pro Basketball Nations.

# **List of predefined tournaments**
 * World: 1994-2023
 * Europe: 2009-2025
 * America: 2015-2025
 * Africa: 2015-2025
 * Asia: 2015-2025

You can play them as is or modify the teams. Some of the tournaments were adjusted to conform the generic template.
For totally custom tournaments you can select 32, 24 or 16 teams template.
